ohmega.configuration.buttonStyle.tooltip:
Style of the accessory inventory button
DEFAULT: The normal Ohmega button style
LEGACY: A curios/baubles inspired button that renders next to the inventory player model
TAG: A small tag-like button appearing just off the top corner of the inventory
HIDDEN: Will not show, use the dedicated keybind to open the accessory inventory instead
ohmega.configuration.compatibilityMode.t: Disables some useful yet mostly unnoticeable features that may improve mod compatibility in rare cases
ohmega.configuration.disableAccessoryTyp: If true, effectively no accessory types will be used, and they will all be overridden, changing them all to "ohmega:generic"
ohmega.configuration.inventorySide.toolt: The side of the inventory that the accessory inventory will be placed
ohmega.configuration.keepAccessoriesBeha:
Defines how to handle player death in terms of dropping accessories
DEFAULT: Uses the vanilla "keepInventory" game-rule
ALWAYS_ON: Will never drop accessories on death
ALWAYS_OFF: Will always drop accessories on death
ohmega.configuration.keyboundSlotTypes.t: Defines the types of accessories that can be key-bound
ohmega.configuration.maxColumnRenderSlot: The maximum amount of slots to render per column
ohmega.configuration.maxColumnSlots.tool:
The maximum amount of slots per column
If exceeded, a new column will be made if it does not exceed "maxColumns"
ohmega.configuration.showHoverTooltip.to: If true, will display a tooltip box of the type of accessory slot when it is hovered over
ohmega.configuration.slotTypes.tooltip: Defines the types and number of slots in the accessory inventory
ohmega.configuration.title: Ohmega Config
